# `sesam show` takes an absolute path inside the repo like a relative one.

exec git init
exec git config user.email test@sesam.dev
exec git config user.name 'Sesam Test'

exec sesam init --user admin

exec sesam show $WORK/README.md
stdout '# Sesam Cheatsheet'
exec sesam show $WORK/.sesam/objects/README.md.sesam
stdout '# Sesam Cheatsheet'
